recent_en: Asia Poly signed a memorandum of understanding on 24 November 2026 and released its quarterly report for the period ended 30 September 2026 on the same day. There were no other significant announcements or news recently.

earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM21,267,000 and net income was RM1,313,000, with a net margin of 6.2%. Revenue grew 37.8% QoQ and net income grew 370.6% QoQ; revenue declined 13.5% YoY, while net margin improved from 1.8% in the previous quarter.
